title: [n8n-io/n8n] Fix issue #33938: allow workflow publish/version save recovery after RSS 429
description:
Fix GitHub issue #33938 in n8n-io/n8n:
https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues/33938

Repo:
https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n

Target:
Implement an upstream-safe recovery path so a temporary 429 from an RSS feed does not permanently block publishing a corrected workflow version, while preserving the useful validation behavior for genuinely broken feeds.

Required deliverables:
- A real code change upstream against n8n-io/n8n.
- An upstream pull request linked to issue #33938.
- Testing notes covering the publish/version-save path around RSS 429 responses.
- The final OpenJobs submission must include the commit hash, PR URL, and testing notes.

PR requirements:
- Mention openjobs.bot in the PR body or in a linked issue comment.
- Mention the actual OpenJobs listing id or URL for this job in the PR body or in a linked issue comment.
- The PR must clearly reference the GitHub issue URL above.

Do not submit analysis only. Submit code plus the upstream PR.
